questions.question: D2 — Which review mode should we use? <gstack-qid:plan-ceo-review-mode>

options.label: A) SELECTIVE EXPANSION (recommended)
options.description: Hold the plan's scope as the baseline, review it with full rigor, then surface expansion opportunities one-by-one for you to cherry-pick. You see what's possible beyond the spec without committing to any of it. Default for feature enhancements.

options.label: B) SCOPE EXPANSION
options.description: Dream big — the review actively proposes the more ambitious version. Every expansion is an individual opt-in. Use if you want to think about what a 10x version of this feature looks like.

options.label: C) HOLD SCOPE
options.description: The plan's scope is accepted as-is. Maximum rigor on architecture, security, edge cases, and observability — no expansions surfaced, no delight opportunities. Use if you just want the plan bulletproofed.

options.label: D) SCOPE REDUCTION
options.description: Propose the minimum viable version that ships value. Cut everything else ruthlessly. Use if the plan feels overbuilt or you want to ship faster.
